homePage.introduction: a UX designer who brings ideas to life through thoughtful design and clean frontend development. I create digital experiences that are intuitive, inclusive, and beautifully crafted.

introText: I'm Cristina Stoian, a UX designer passionate about creating intuitive and meaningful digital experiences. I approach each project with empathy and curiosity, always aiming to solve real user problems.

Through user research, wireframes, prototypes, and continuous iteration, I design with clarity and purpose. My background in frontend development helps me translate ideas into responsive, accessible interfaces.
This portfolio reflects my values: usability, thoughtful design, and a deep commitment to improving people’s experiences.
Thank you for stopping by, I hope you enjoy exploring my work!

advicePage.adviceDescription: Interactive web app displaying advice dynamically from the Advice Slip API. A dice button allows quick generation of new tips. The modern layout is styled with CSS and Google Fonts for an enjoyable experience.

jokeTellerPage.jokeDescription: Interactive web app that dynamically fetches and reads jokes using JokeAPI and VoiceRSS. Buttons allow users to generate a joke or navigate to an info page.
jokeTellerPage.noJoke: Press the button to hear a joke!

todoPage.todoDescription: React app for task management, allowing users to add, edit, delete, and mark tasks as completed. Uses hooks like useState for state management and modular components for an intuitive interface.
todoPage.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Task Management App

figoRestPage.description: A modern, responsive restaurant website created with HTML and CSS, focusing on clean UX and UI design. The site features an interactive menu, gallery, testimonials, and a news section, all structured with intuitive navigation and a mobile-first approach. The design highlights a fresh color palette, clear typography, and card-based layouts to make the menu easy to scan and visually engaging. Accessibility was considered through contrast, alt text for images, and simple navigation, while responsiveness ensures the site adapts smoothly to any device. This project helped me practice building a visually appealing interface while applying core UX principles.

joggaPage.pageTitle: Jogga.ro Transition from React.js to Next.js
joggaPage.description: I contributed to migrating Jogga.ro to Next.js, optimizing load times and SEO through server-side rendering, dynamic content loading, and image optimization.
joggaPage.imageAlt: Interactive map from the Jogga.ro project
keyContributions: Fetched and displayed data dynamically via API.
Optimized UI components for better user experience.
Implemented lazy loading for images.
Created an interactive map with markers.
joggaPage.outcome: The project improved Jogga.ro’s performance and strengthened my expertise in Next.js and React.

customWebDevDescription: Crafting responsive, interactive, and visually appealing websites using React. Ensuring compatibility across various devices and browsers.
uiUxDesignDescription: Translating design prototypes (Figma, Adobe XD) into functional web interfaces. Prioritizing user experience and accessibility.

maintenanceDescription: Offering ongoing website maintenance and updates. Troubleshooting and fixing bugs.

cswebPage.description: I designed and developed a professional, scalable web platform for a digital service provider with a strong focus on UX principles. The process included user research, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, and implementing a responsive, accessible interface. I ensured intuitive navigation, clear visual hierarchy, and smooth interactions to enhance user satisfaction and engagement.
keyContributions: User research and persona development to guide design decisions
Wireframing and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma
Responsive and accessible UI design for all devices
Clear information architecture and navigation flow
Usability testing and iterative improvements
Internationalization using react-i18next
Engaging visuals with Iconify icons and flag assets
Contact form integration via Formspree
Optimized media with WebP and lazy loading
SEO best practices: semantic HTML, fast load times
cswebPage.outcome: The project delivered a scalable, user-centered platform designed to meet client goals while ensuring a seamless and enjoyable user experience.
cswebPage.imageAlt: Screenshots from the CSWeb UX project

tttPage.pageTitle: Tauschen, Teilen, Tragen – Local Second-hand App
tttPage.description: I designed and developed a user-centered app for the Weilheim an der Teck community to help neighbors swap, share, and wear clothes sustainably. The process included user interviews, wireframes, Figma prototypes, and usability tests to ensure a clear and accessible experience.
keyContributions: User research and personas tailored to local needs
Wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma
Responsive, accessible UI across devices
Clear information architecture and intuitive navigation
Usability testing and iterative improvements
Community features: messaging and neighbor recommendations
Fast product filtering and simple search
Media optimization with WebP and lazy loading
Trust & safety measures (profiles/neighborhood focus)
Local focus to increase relevance and trust
tttPage.outcome: The project delivered a friendly, sustainable, community-oriented platform that helps neighbors easily swap, share, and wear clothing.
tttPage.imageAlt: Screenshots from the UX case study “Tauschen, Teilen, Tragen”
